task.subject: Fix double-bracketing of choices in synopsis

winning_diff:
--- a/src/click/core.py
+++ b/src/click/core.py
@@ -2988,12 +2988,17 @@ class Argument(Parameter):
     def make_metavar(self, ctx: Context) -> str:
         if self.metavar is not None:
             return self.metavar
         var = self.type.get_metavar(param=self, ctx=ctx)
         if not var:
             var = self.name.upper()
         if self.deprecated:
             var += "!"
-        if not self.required:
-            var = f"[{var}]"
-        if self.nargs != 1:
-            var += "..."
+        # If the type already provided its own brackets (e.g. ``Choice``
+        # returns ``[a|b|c]``), don't add a second pair when the argument is
+        # optional. Similarly, only append ``...`` when nargs != 1 and the
+        # type did not already do so.
+        if not self.required and not (var.startswith("[") and var.endswith("]")):
+            var = f"[{var}]"
+        if self.nargs != 1 and not var.endswith("..."):
+            var += "..."
         return var
